notes.title: Quarantine is out of Early Access! New features and scenario!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27451397/cbb15de37175f51024d4c2ffe80db2128d8b748a.png[/img]

https://youtu.be/ZLUTSrmcFFI

505 Games and Sproing Games are happy to announce that Quarantine, the real-time strategy game that pits you against global outbreaks of disease, has exited Early Access and is available NOW on Steam! With a host of new features, the time is right to take the Director’s chair and get to work! 

Our community has played an integral role in shaping what Quarantine has become during the Early Access period. We said from the outset that we were focused on moving the genre forward and, with your support and input, have been able to shape a truly unique experience.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27451397/22d86291cb609435ec1b6c4fc2245bb198979b2e.png[/img]

For new Directors, your time to take the lead in the battle against global outbreaks is now! Be sure to visit our forums to talk with other Directors and share strategies! For those that have been here since day 1, we thank you for your input and dedication, and are happy to share the following new features with you. 

- New scenario: Fungus – this scenario will see our Directors take a whole new approach to battling an unknown disease.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27451397/5143205fc0acefc1415c549a4780ae927252baa0.jpg[/img]


 - Steam Workshop - Name your disease and events! 

- Operative base spawning: Choose where you start battling the disease after the outbreak has made its first move. 

Directions for the Steam Workshop support can be found on the official Quarantine Wiki.

https://quarantine.gamepedia.com/Steam_Workshop

notes.title: UPDATE v0.1.2.0 AVAILABLE NOW – NEW EBOLA DISEASE ADDED AND MORE! PLUS, GET QUARANTINE 34% OFF FOR A LIMITED TIME
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27451397/55050f5ca0ce98a369100d43b1bd517bf1781e0d.jpg[/img]

Hello Directors! Update v0.1.2.0 is OUT NOW. We’ve introduced an ALL-NEW Ebola disease scenario, operative and event improvements and more! See below for more details. Download today and get to work.

Have you been holding out from taking the Director’s chair? Jump in now and save! Quarantine is 34% off for a limited time. With all new content and improvements, the time is NOW to take on outbreaks across the globe and save humanity!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27451397/7fe4b4e51198f515d4506455489c79fef833d114.png[/img]

Added New Disease Scenario – Ebola!
o        Minimize fatalities across the globe as this real-world outbreak gains momentum and begins to spread in Africa
          - New events
          - Special starting conditions
          - New map layout   

New Operative Movement
o        Many players suggested this change, and we agree! Operatives must now travel from city to city using movement points.
o        Overall this should make operative & disease locations much more important, and add a new layer of strategy.
o        To use an operative, first select an operative, then the target city (within range), then the operation.

Enhanced Events
o        Lots of balance changes
o        Event response options now show positive and negative effects. This should give you much better information before making a decision.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27451397/83b3ff4e7af26af4d88c643355088d44b06364f1.png[/img]

Improved Disease Visualization
o        The new visualization shows:
          - The origin city (“FROM”) and destination city (“TO”) during a disease spread action
          - Attacks on quarantine zones
          - General graphical improvements

New End of Turn Reminders
o        At the end of the turn, you’ll be reminded if you still need to:
         - Start a tech research
         - Start a lab research (if you have enough samples)
         - Give orders to idle operatives

notes.title: Quarantine Update v0.1.1.0 Now Available
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27451397/028ccc4e20740f6ef3fe6ee19cab6ff75082eae8.png[/img]

Directors Mobilize! We are pleased to announce that our first update for Quarantine is now available. Update  v0.1.1.0 contains a number of new additions outlined below. Also, in case you missed it, we have already pushed a few bug fixes and a tuning update that increased the difficulty level on ‘hard’ mode for all 3 scenarios.

NEW ADDITIONS:

•        IMPROVED DISEASE INFORMATION: The disease infection bar now has a tooltip that reveals exactly how many ‘spread’ and ‘intensify’ actions the disease has each turn, as well as the chance of spawning a negative situation. This information should help you understand the disease’s behavior and plan your strategy accordingly.
•        DISEASE MUTATION BAR: We’ve also added a mutation bar that shows when the disease is investing in mutating – and how close it is. This should help clarify how this mechanic works, and allow you to respond.
•        RESEARCH NOTIFICATIONS: When you complete disease or tech research, the game now notifies you much more clearly so you can select new research. Many players requested this – thank you for the suggestion, keep them coming!
•        ACHIEVEMENTS: We've added 3 new achievements inspired by community suggestions! What other achievements do you want to see in-game? Let us know and you might just see it added on the next update!
                 * Careless: Win all 3 scenarios without using the ""Heal Operative"" operation on hard difficulty. Thanks to Sniper___Prime for the idea.
                 * Dynamic Duo: Win all 3 scenarios by hiring only 1 additional operative on at least medium difficulty. Thanks to Sniper___Prime for the idea.
                 * Headstart: Win all 3 scenarios after not treating nor quarantining for the first 4 turns on hard difficulty. Thanks to Sniper___Prime for the idea.

We will continue to push more robust updates in the coming months and are working on incorporating your feedback. Thanks again for all of your support and again, keep the suggestions coming!

notes.title: Quarantine Tuning & Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27451397/8620d436c3ea1109e9b497b8f5d6c7e600b01f70.jpg[/img]

We’ve made some bug fixes and updates to game tuning. Please see full list below and don’t forget to report any additional technical issues or EA suggestions in our sub-forum. Thanks for your continued support! 

1.        The stability of the tutorial was improved
2.        Adjusting the Windows 10 text scaling doesn’t negatively affect the game resolution anymore
3.        The correct sample information is now shown when an operative levels up (thanks to zazyman32 for using the new mailbox to report this bug) 
4.        The “End Turn” button is now disabled as long the event window is shown
5.        Rebalanced tech tree to even out strengths of all sub-trees
6.        Increased the difficulty on hard on all 3 scenarios

Hello Quarantine community! It’s been a short while since the game launched and we are happy to see all of you already getting in and giving feedback. We are happy to announce that a Bug Fix has been pushed that will address the following issues:

·         All achievements should work now, including these listed below:
Intern 
Doctor 
Savior 
Globetrotter 
Jack of all trades 
Speedrun 

·  We removed all hardcoded local texts and fixed some Chinese and Russian errors.

·  Operations don’t change sorting anymore when upgrading them via tech.

- The chosen operative doesn’t change anymore when you choose a different operation.

Thank you!

notes.title: What diseases will you face in Quarantine?
notes.content:
Quarantine is a race to survival and tests your ability to overcome deadly disease. Let’s check out what you’ll be up against.

- Prion: Intensifying fast in infected cities. Very similar to BSE, managed to infect several people around the world. It seems to have a hard time crossing city borders but is extremely contagious within cities.

- Virus: High mutation rate. Potential to be a global threat. It mutates faster than we can sequence it, we need to find the cure as fast as possible!

- Bacteria: Spreading fast to uninfected cities. A new strain of anti-biotic resistant bacteria has emerged in various cities on the world. It spreads incredibly fast from city to city, we must act fast to prevent it from spreading over the whole world!

notes.title: The characters you will guide in Quarantine – Diplomats and Scientists
notes.content:
Today, we’re happy to share more information about the classes of character you’ll be guiding in Quarantine! While our Medics and Security play integral rolls, Diplomats and Scientists bring about a new form of hope for survival. 

- Diplomats: The voice of Pan-Def. Diplomats are responsible for negotiations, political affairs and the economic stability of our organization.

- Scientists: The cure is our only hope. Gathering samples and figuring out the disease to ultimately find the cure is the top priority for this sub-group of our organization.

notes.title: Learn more about Quarantine, coming to Early Access on February 9!
notes.content:
Quarantine comes to Early Access on February 9! Check out some key features below!

- Immersive  graphics and authentic setting. Inspired by real-world science and epidemic response, experience the tough choices and nail-biting suspense in this modern fight for humanity.

- Battle against 3 lethal pathogens: virus, bacteria, and prion — each with unique behaviors and devastating effects.

- Recruit your team. Choose from dozens of operatives in four specializations—Medic, Scientist, Diplomat, and Security. Deploy them on missions as critical situations unfold around the globe. Level them up—and keep them alive—in the face of escalating danger.

- Expand your reach. Set up field bases and raise crucial funding. Don’t let cities fall into chaos: the livelihood of your organization—and the world—depends on it.

- Devious disease AI. Contain your enemy before it infects new sites and spawns catastrophic events. Race against the clock before the contagion mutates and evolves past your defenses.

- Advance your tech. Unlock upgrades and new operations on the diverse tech tree to adapt your strategy and refine your play style.

- Hit the lab. Collect biological samples from hotspots to research the disease’s randomly generated traits. Use the results to turn the tide and find the cure.

- Hours of replayability. Increase your resistance with easy challenges so you can endure Nature’s worst. Three difficulty modes, four leaders, a variety of starting locations, and unpredictable gameplay ensure that no two games are the same.

tags.feature: - Immersive  graphics and authentic setting. Inspired by real-world science and epidemic response, experience the tough choices and nail-biting suspense in this modern fight for humanity.
- Battle against 3 lethal pathogens: virus, bacteria, and prion — each with unique behaviors and devastating effects.

- Recruit your team. Choose from dozens of operatives in four specializations—Medic, Scientist, Diplomat, and Security. Deploy them on missions as critical situations unfold around the globe. Level them up—and keep them alive—in the face of escalating danger.
- Expand your reach. Set up field bases and raise crucial funding. Don’t let cities fall into chaos: the livelihood of your organization—and the world—depends on it.
- Devious disease AI. Contain your enemy before it infects new sites and spawns catastrophic events. Race against the clock before the contagion mutates and evolves your defenses.
- Advance your tech. Unlock upgrades and new operations on the diverse tech tree to adapt your strategy and refine your play style.
